description: This Java class 'ThingAclValidator' provides validation logic for Access Control Lists (ACLs) associated with 'Things'. It uses an internal 'AclValidator' to ensure ACLs adhere to minimum permission requirements and is part of a deprecated API version 1 for access control management.

classes.name: ThingAclValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing Validator, used to validate ACLs for 'Things' according to specific rules. It includes factory methods for instantiation and validation methods.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ThingAclValidator with a specified AccessControlList. Throws NullPointerException if the argument is null.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the ACL contains at least one Authorization Subject with the required permissions (READ, WRITE, ADMINISTRATE). Returns false if not, true otherwise.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an Optional<String> explaining the reason if validation fails, otherwise an empty Optional.
